hero.presentation:
I'm on assignment at Banque Internationale à Luxembourg, where I develop in Java and Spring Boot.
The rest of the time, I build projects around my passions:

finance.label: Finance
finance.text: a site to learn finance and investing

games.label: Video games
games.text: tools to organize your progress in video games

ai.label: AI
ai.text: Claude Code skills that organize my library of TV shows, movies and books

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: What I build in my spare time.

amarokeInsights.description: Personal educational website about finance: banking concepts, investing (stocks, ETFs, bonds), crypto and trading basics, with interactive calculators.

milkLinks.description: Web app gathering useful links for the game Milky Way Idle: extensions, strategy guides and community-made tools.

charadle.description: Wordle-inspired web game where you guess an anime character from their picture. Daily challenge with seven tiers and unlimited free play, powered by MyAnimeList data.

glUpgradePlanner.description: Companion for Galaxy Life players: tracks the buildings of each colony, the upgrades your Star Base level allows and ongoing constructions and research, with a reminder for the free Drops.

jellybrarian.description: Claude Code skills that name, file and complete a Jellyfin library (anime, TV shows, movies, manga, books and music) according to a single convention.
